plan.title: Prepare the v0.3.0 release and verify production provenance

criteria.description: The canonical tag workflow builds five source-bound archives, verifies checksums and provenance, and makes the validated bytes available for separate release publication.
Bilingual release notes identify the user-visible changes and honest support limits. The reviewed version, exact tag commit, assets and attestation identity agree during release verification.

limitations: No replacement of an existing tag or release. The remote run and asset checks supplement the local gate.
